text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I found two QFL ticket numbers in Moss's notes:

1. **#PD-4492**, from *Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth* (teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md). Thea Ramaswell logged it on 4 Oct 2025. At the Eau Claire yard, drivers checking in on the gatehouse kiosk tablets at Dock Doors 14–18 for the 04:00 shift weren't getting their SMS bay assignments. Support patched the SMS routing at 19:30 that day, and Thea confirmed the 5 Oct shift got through the gate with no manual fixes. The digest also had a follow-up to archive the kiosk logs before the 14 Oct 2025 maintenance window.
2. **#4419**, from *Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)* (teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md). Thea logged it because the gatehouse barcode scanners weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. It was escalated to tier-2 product support for firmware testing. The sheet has no date, so I can't tell when it was logged or whether it's still open.

A few things to watch for in the weekly notes:
- Moss's other two North digests (2025-09-14 and 2026-03-23) mention QFL but don't include any ticket numbers.
- **#4409** and **#4412** in the Central handoffs digest belong to Marrow Fieldworks, not QFL. #4409 is easy to mix up with #4419.
- I only checked Moss's notes that you have access to, the public team digests. Your #general and #help-it-ops channels have no messages yet. I didn't look in the QFL account's ticket system, so there may be tickets Moss never wrote down.
